reviews.text: The team over at rox falls bet is really wonderful and helpful very compassionate and clear in their communication.  I lost my cat last year and they did everything they could to prepare me for the inevitable.
Extremely kind and compassionate care at Rox Falls Vet. Best veterinarian practice in the Manayunk/Roxborough area
Catherine, thank you for your 4-star review! If there’s anything we can do to make your next visit even better, we’d love to hear your feedback.

I do not have enough good things to say about Rox Falls Vet. We had to get our cat in for an emergency visit and Dr. Theresa Herbers was so kind. She was so patient with us during what was a very difficult visit. I cannot recommend Dr. Herbers & the clinic more. Thank you guys for your support & patience.

Amazing experience at the Rox Falls vet! My cats were so comfortable and at ease with Nurse Evan and Dr. Herbers. They spent a full hour with my girls and did thorough exams and talked me through all my concerns. Very clean “cat only” room and they were well separated from dogs. Never had such a great experience with the vet, my girls are excited to see them again next time!

My cats are new patients here, and I am very pleased that we decided on this practice. Every person I spoke with was kind and empathetic, it’s clear they really care about the animals. The doctor walked us patiently through everything, and I could tell that they cared about us, the people, too. My cats will be going back
Jan, thank you so much for the 5-star review. We're glad you had a great experience with us!
Wenesday, thank you for your support and for taking the time to leave us a review. 🐾 …

Found this vet from people online saying they were affordable. Couldn't have anticipated how compassionate and sweet the entire staff is. Our cat was having trouble and they were really supportive through all of his end of life care. So thankful for these wonderful people
Excellent communication and attention to concerns. Center is very clean and organized
Jeremy, thank you for the 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and trust in our team. 🐾 …

Really sweet vet, and very kind. I was so worried about my senior cat and they explained everything in detail and helped us work through what was going on. They were up front anout pricing and even broke it all down for us on paper as to what it would be. Good wait times as well! They were able to fit us in last minute and take care of us 🩷

Where to start!  Rox Falls Vet is everything you want in a vet!  From the front desk staff to the nurse to the doctor, this place truly made me feel at ease and welcomed.  I walked in with an urgent care need and Yasmine stopped what she was doing to truly listen and help me out.  She got me in on the same day and was courtesy enough to explain there is a higher fee for same day appointments, which I was totally okay with. When I arrived later with my reactive dog, Yasmine was quick to find us a room and make sure the lobby was clear of any other pets.

Nurse Samantha was super sweet, professional, and attentive.  She listened to my concerns which included our dog being super lethargic, uninterested, and consistently sleeping a week and a half after some normal procedures while he was sedated at another vet.

Dr. Steph was truly the best as well!  She was also very attentive, kind, and helpful!  Our dog is a pitbull mix rescue who is very guarded and Dr. Steph (and the rest of her staff) worked diligently to meet the needs of our guy, rather than giving up.  Even when he got snappy, they were quick to give him space and brainstorm some other ways they could work with him.  By the end of the visit they were able to successfully flush him with IV fluids to help his body dispose of any sedation toxins (plus hydration) since he has kidney issues (without drugging him!). Dr. Steph talked with me about a kidney friendly diet and helped set up some prescription foods for him.  Samantha sent us home with some supplements such as omega oil and probiotic capsules. Dr. Steph even followed up the next day by just calling to check in!

I cannot thank this place enough for their patience, kindness, and the overall care they gave our boy!  I will certainly be coming back! :)

PS- Our dog has been so much more himself since our visit!!
They really take care of our pets! Thank you Rox Falls for helping Bella!
Rox Falls vet was amazing every step! Dr. Herbers and the rest of the staff were so patient and accommodating with me and my reactive pup. Highly recommend!

Rox Falls always takes great care of our cat Emmy! Wellness visits have always been seamless and we love that they offer urgent care visits. Emmy broke one of her claws, and they were able to get us in the same day to be checked out and they prescribed pain meds for her. I cannot recommend Rox Falls enough!
We love Rox Falls Vet! Everyone is so kind and helpful.
love these guys. they really care about you & your pet.

I used to take my cat up there as Simba sometime ago and they weren’t even in the back for like five minutes, trying to trim his nails and when I brought him home, I don’t think they did a good very good job so that’s why I’m not going up there anymore so And you and you overcharged people It did not very good job on trimming his nails so that’s why I’m not coming up there anymore. OK I’m going back to the one I used to go to the nicer not that you were nice, but I’m sorry. that’s why I gave you a very very low review. If there was a zero I would give it up to you and you are a zero.

We can not recommend highly enough! All staff from Doctor Mike to all the nurses and receptionists were very professional and accommodating. They made sure we were comfortable and understanding of the process of our pets surgery. They truly have our pets best health in mind and we are very grateful to them!
Everyone at RFV is kind, caring, and super helpful. They have been our vet for 3 years and my pets have been so well taken care of. It is a good feeling to find such a great vet’s office.

I CANT GIVE ENOUGH KUDOS TO THIS PRACTICE!!
We went to them for a second opinion on our 15 year old Bengal cat.  After several senior blood panels over a course of 6 months in which we were prescribed antibiotics and he had several shots of anti-nausea medication. It all wore off quickly and we were feeling like we were right back where we started from.  So we went to Rox Falls where my daughter brings her golden retriever.
Dr. Lindsay did a senior blood panel again and was concerned with the higher than normal white cell count and also his vomiting, unusual crouching/avoidance and peeing outside the litter box. We opted for an ultrasound with them. Dr.. Mike called a few days later with bad news that there was a mass in his stomach and another in his small intestine which he said looked very sick. We got medication but he wasn’t improving. When I spoke with to Dr. Mike he left it up to us. We could pursue further medical intervention or, nurse him along for a few months.
We’ve had MANY cats and been down this road before.
I called Dr. Mike to say he deserved a noble passing as he was a noble cat. He was so supportive of our decision and helped us get him through to the rainbow bridge as did the whole team at Rox Falls. Our Shih Tzu baby will be seeing them soon
All we can say is THANK YOU THANK YOU❤️❤️

All of the staff seem nice but they are very unorganized. Also, the one time a vet tech had to give a vaccine to my cat and she somehow missed and had to stick him twice. They also said that my cat received a dog Lyme disease vaccine but that was not true.
The staff was absolutely amazing. Lovely experience from the phone call, to the front desk, to the vet. They put me and my kitty completely at ease in an emergency situation.
Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Elba. We're glad you had a great experience with us!

I cannot stay enough good things about Rox Falls Vet. We came to them for the first for an urgent care visit. They found a heart issue with my senior dog and worked some magic to get us an appointment with a cardiologist to treat her in time. She needed a pacemaker.  She would have died had we needed to wait.  We were able to another year with our sweet girl. They were amazing through everything, including calls to simply check-in to see how we were doing.
We now have a puppy and he is super happy to be at the Vet! Everyone on staff from the tech, to the vets, to the assistants behind the desk are just the best.
Very professional and kind veterinary practice that truly love and take care of your furry family!  Highly recommend.

My cat has been a patient here for both urgent care and regular wellness visits and I cannot sing their praises enough. They’re compassionate with me and my baby every single time I walk through their doors. My cat literally starts purring when brought in.

I took my cat here for her regular check up and from start to finish had an excellent experience!
The staff member on the phone who booked my appointment was so kind. Even asked nicknames I use for my cat!
The vet tech Sabrina and Dr Berardino were so good with my cat, who was very nervous to be there. (This appointment was on a Saturday by the way— it says a lot that the staff was so pleasant while working on a weekend!!)  They had a great sense of humor, were thorough in their care, and even took her to a separate room for her bloodwork and vaccines (I appreciate this a lot as someone who gets a bit squeamish). I am planning to take all of my animals to Rox falls — can’t recommend it enough!
Thanks for the review, Jhon! Our team appreciates it.

Amazing vet. My dog Denver usually doesn't like going to the vet, but everyone there was so sweet, and he loved all of the staff. They were so courteous and knowledgeable and answered all my questions. And they made sure to check on Denver a week later, which was incredibly sweet. I highly, highly recommend this vet, they are the best

Rox Falls Vet is amazing! All the nurses and doctors are super nice and caring! I brought my cat in due to some kind of lumps we felt under her fur. Instead of ordering expensive tests to figure out the issue (which is what our old vet in South Philly would have done), the vet just shaved some fur and figured out it was just some scarring from scratches that my cat did to herself. Also we have a dog with a large growth on her belly and the surgery went really well and it was a lot less expensive than we thought it would be. Location is also super convenient and has a parking lot. Much easier to get to than the South Philly vet we used to use. Facility is clean and modern. Thank you to all the wonderful staff, nurses, and doctors at Rox Falls Vet for taking care of my fur babies!
Thank you for the 5 stars! We love caring for your pets!

I’ve been bringing my dog here for about 3 years now and we’re so happy to have this team available. I have a senior pit mix who always seems to have something going on, sometimes minor but for handful of occasions, we’ve had a serious worry. No matter what the issue is, the team is always responsive, compassionate, and knowledgeable in how they help. It’s clear that everyone here loves pets. They do a great job keeping the waiting room calm and under crowded, the facility is always clean, and their prices are fair. Most importantly, their entire staff really rocks (I guess you could say they rox). The communication is top notch, from scheduling through the appointment itself. If there’s ever been an issue, they’ve been wonderful in coming up with an appropriate solution. They take pride in their work and we’re so happy to continue being a client of theirs!

I will start by saying that I've been taking my dog Bourbon and cat Belle to Rox Falls Vet for 2 years. Mainly yearly exams and the occasional nail trim. On Sunday, April 19, I was dealing with my poodles declining health throughout the day. I was in contact with the er vet I had taken him to the previous night and was planning on taking him back, since they had already treated him. Just before I left, Bourbons condition worsened and I didn't know if he would even make it to the other vet. I called
RFV just as they were closing and they stayed open and whisked Bourbon into the back and immediately started working on him. In the end, I did what was best for my almost 14 year old dog, but the care and support they showed was amazing. I would like to thank the whole staff for the care they showed that day. Kaitlyn was literally waiting with open arms when I got there to start working on Bourbon and Dr. Caitlin Adams was gentle and supportive when I made the tough decision. I would highly recommend Rox Falls Vet to anyone in the area.

While I see (and love) the care team for my two cats on a regular basis, I have to give a shout out to Dr. Mike and the team at Rox Falls Vet this past Thursday. My cat had some tummy issues and I was able to get him to the vet within 15 mins from when I called the front desk and explained his symptoms. They were super accommodating while being extremely busy, which this very nervous cat mom truly appreciated. My cat is now feeling sooo much better, and we also have a treatment plan in place to fix the root cause of the issue. I truly feel like I can talk to anyone at Rox Falls Vet and they will go above and beyond for my cats. I couldn’t ask for better doctors and staff around!!!

I can’t say enough about the care we received from Rox Falls Vet. I called in a complete panic before they even opened, and despite having no availability, they told me to bring Snookums in and kept her for observation throughout the day.

They called me shortly after drop-off with updates and a clear plan for next steps, and by the afternoon I had answers and my baby back home. Every single staff member treated her with so much love - snuggling her and making sure she felt comfortable and safe. The vet took time to walk me through everything in detail, and they’ve followed up for two days after just to check on her.

They truly took me off the ledge. I’m beyond grateful for their compassion and exceptional care.

The vets here are great! They spend plenty of time with you at each appointment, take a genuine interest in your animals, and they even message you after to follow up on treatment to see how your baby is doing. So far we've seen Dr. Mike, and he's amazing! They've definitely been a great addition to the community, and are importantly locally owned (not a Private Equity vet roll up).

I would not recommend this vet based on my experience. The lack of communication was extremely frustrating messages went unanswered, follow-ups were inconsistent, and I had to chase down basic information about my pet’s care. It felt disorganized and, at times, dismissive.

Very thorough and gentle with my cat, suffering from a yeast infection in her ears. I was initially concerned about the application of Revolution for mites and seeming loss of hair, but it was just matting and this morning she is fine.
We're grateful for your 4-star review, Rashien! Thank you for trusting us with your pet's health. We'd love to hear if there's anything we can do to improve your experience! ❤️
Squeezed us in same day so my cat could be seen for an eye infection. Absolutely nothing bad to say.
Thanks so much for the review, Lauren!

We love Rox Falls Vet! Everyone on the team is incredibly kind, knowledgeable, and thoughtful. From check-in to check-out, the entire process is seamless, and they always make us feel at ease.

At our most recent visit, Dr. Herbers took the time to sit with us and ensure every question was answered and that our dog felt comfortable. We never once felt rushed or dismissed. She is truly exceptional.

Also, Carrie and Ayanna are the best! They went above and beyond to help our incredibly, incredibly nervous dog get through blood work, while also reassuring me every step of the way. We are so grateful for the expertise, compassion, and care we receive at Rox Falls!

I’m not sure how these people keep the lights on…oh yeah they over charge for everything.
So if you want to be disrespected, not heard. And have your animals harmed please go to ROX Vets.  Worst experience for my animals and myself.  They keep harassing me now with phone calls and emails because they know they were wrong. Out of the 5+ emails no one apologized…really?
“Every email started with “I’m sorry you feel that”….unbelievable.  The vet hurt my dog, and when we got home he couldn’t even put weight on his leg.  He didn’t have any issues with his knee.
.They just didn’t want a negative review because they probably can’t afford it.  I should have known when I walked in no one was there except for one other client…it’s a not a busy practice for a reason, it’s over staffed…and Dr B…assumed everything without having a discussion with me…worst experience ever couldn’t get a word in, he talked over me the whole time and I should have walked out and listened to my gut…I will never return.  I’m going to go back to NJ for my vet visits…I’d rather spend an hour driving to their previous vet because she was amazing and didn’t harm my babies, over charge me and spend over 30 minutes with me discussing and giving me choices.
I really don’t recommend this place…they had the nerve to tell me they would reexamine my dog they hurt for another office visit that I would have to pay for!  Don’t go there!
This practice is always so caring and thorough. They’re reasonable about rates and don’t arbitrarily inflate them like many vets. They legitimately care about and remember your furry family members.
Great service first make an appointment.I'm well respected people
Thanks for the 5 stars! It means everything to know you're happy with our care! 😊 …
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Thank you for the 5 stars!

I took my cat Louie to Rox Falls Vet for the first time today, and the staff was incredibly kind and gentle with him. I recently lost another cat, and they showed such compassion and understanding for my loss. I truly appreciate the care and kindness Louie and I received
Really really good experience.  Very attentive and took there time. I was very nervous switching Vets for my dog but I am glad I did 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 🌟 …

I have a senior cat who has not been able to get a physical exam in years (more like a decade) due to aggressive behavior. My first appointment with Dr. Lindsay established a detailed plan using medication to calm my cat’s anxiety for the next visit. Honestly, I was skeptical; my cat does NOT like to be touched by anyone other than me! I did as Dr. Lindsay instructed and to my own surprise, it actually worked! Not only was my senior cat tolerable, they were able to take a blood sample AND give vaccines without any hissing or biting! I am still shocked by this experience. Dr. Lindsay also credited me the cost of the physical since we were not able to do so at the first appointment. These people truly care about animals and know what they are doing. I won’t trust anyone else with my kitty! I would give Dr. Lindsay and staff 10 stars if I could.

I have been to three vets just from moving around and this is by far the best. I have had my three cats come here, and based on each cat's needs, the staff adjusts to make sure that they are reducing any stress from their visit. Always super clean and friendly!
Alfie approves ✅
We really appreciate you taking the time to leave us a 5-star review, James!

Dr. Lindsay Berardino is by far the best vet we have ever had. She saved our 6 month old kitten and continued to take care of her (and us!) for the following year. She is compassionate, composed, caring, knowledgeable, and incredibly kind. I would follow her to whatever practice she goes!

Her accolades aside, we are consistently grateful for the quick and efficient care we get at Rox Falls. Their vets are cost conscious and have our pets at the forefront of their mind. Not only that, but their nurses and front desk staff are always helpful, kind, and informed. They take the time to answer as many questions as you may have!

Had our first visit to establish care after a move to PA, and as someone who cares for her dog more than herself I was anxious to find a practice that cared as much as I do. And boy do I think I found it! Every person we interacted with welcomed my dog by name and was so sweet and welcoming. The nurse and doctor were both very helpful with explaining everything they recommend and why and showcased so much attention to detail I appreciated it so much. It was very clear that the nurse and doctor had thoroughly reviewed my dog's previous records prior to the appointment, just another example of how wonderful they are. When discussing potential blood work for a future visit, we were provided a price estimate (VERY fair!) which isn't always the case at vets, sometimes it's sticker shock at check out but not here. I love that they keep appointments open for emergencies each day, that gives me peace of mind for any potential issues. Very clean facility and the parking lot around back was convenient. I received a follow up text today checking in on my pup after her appointment and a vaccine yesterday. I definitely made the right decision with Rox Falls Vet!

I am very disappointed with the lack of communication I have received from Rox Falls Vet. I took my cat there back in October because he seemed slightly off, and I was told that he has pillow foot. After the initial appointment and paying over $800 for them to run labs to diagnose the issue, he was put on medication (which was $50 +1 month supply). The follow-up appointment was a few weeks later and went fine, but it was $93 for that visit. I was instructed to keep him on the medication for a few more weeks and to schedule another follow-up, so I had to place a refill for the medication for another $50.

When it came time for the next follow-up appointment, we had to get lab work done again to check his progress, and this was right before Thanksgiving. I asked if I could now taper him off the medication and was told to wait until the lab results came back, but due to the holiday, it might be delayed and I should hear back by Monday 12/1. This visit cost $285.

December 1 came and went, so I reached out on 12/3 to follow up on the results. I was told, "As soon as those results are received, Dr. Theresa will be reaching out to communicate them to you." A week and a half passed with no word. I reached out again on 12/11 and was told, "I apologize for the delay on this—I'm checking in on this with Gizmo's care team for you." Again, there was no further response after that, so I reached out once more today and am still waiting to hear back.

His medication is also due for renewal again, which means another $50. These visits are not cheap and add up quickly, but paying over $1300 within seven weeks with no response for three weeks and counting after the last visit is unacceptable. I don't understand how anyone can run a business, especially in the medical field, with such poor communication. I'm starting to have a lack of confidence in the doctors at this facility because all they do is recommend more tests but can't even deliver results.

Very compassionate and humane, and super communicative, while practical in offering advice and being mindful and transparent about cost. We've been through a LOT with our pets medically in the last few months, and we are so, so lucky to have found Rox Falls before all that happened. They have been so incredibly kind and professional from every doctor, to the entire front desk, and whole vet tech team, wonderful to us, our cat, and our dog. Cannot recommend highly enough. We really appreciate the practice of leaving a little room booking schedule for same-day emergency appointments, but make sure you call first thing, because they are limited and fill up fast.
The staff and vets are outstanding.
Always a great experience there.

The best vet clinic I have ever used and I've had dogs and/or cats since Nixon. The wait time is very short and the time spent with a doctor never feels rushed. Dr Herbers is very thorough and thoughtful. I believe my pup is getting the best care I could ever wish for.
Thank you for the 5 stars! We love caring for your pets!
I love this place! So responsive, so kind. Hardly a wait. They are terrific for my puppy.

Best vet I’ve ever been to— from the front desk staff to the nursing assistants to the vets—they have all been amazing. We’ve done surgery for kidney stones for our cat, (Bagheera) that turned out wonderfully and no problems years later and now we have our dog (Shadow) that loves going to this vet. Everyone has great vibes so you can tell it’s a well-run company, and as it’s not run by private equity you can tell they’re recommending best practice procedures—not unnecessary ones. As we were bringing in Shadow Dr. Mike recommended to schedule spaying so we could use the same labs we were already paying for after as the timing was good. The vets double-check their radiology scans with a radiologist. They’re open 7 days a week. I drop by with Shadow returning from a play-date with bloody back paws and even though I had no appointment and it was a Sunday they examined her paws, & cleaned her up as a complimentary service. As neither of us have ever grown up with dogs having a great neighborhood vet so close-by coupled with a good pet insurance gives us peace of mind—no matter what foreign object our puppy decides to ingest :) Whoever runs this place probably needs a vacation!
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Thank you for the 5 stars!

I bring my 3 dogs to Rox Falls Vet. The entire staff is so caring and welcoming. The doctors remember me and my dogs and when I bring one in, they ask me how the others are doing. I’m so impressed with this level of care and will continue to bring my dogs here. I highly recommend.
We're grateful for your 4-star review! Thank you for trusting us with your pet's health. We'd love to hear if there's anything we can do to improve your experience! ❤️
Great staff. Friendly, welcoming, knowledgeable. Help putt mind at ease.
I like this vet. The staff are thorough and kind. They were able to help my daughter's cat.

Our entire experience for the first phone call to make an appointment. To call in the next day to get an urgent care appointment. Not only was the dog anxious I was too he is a Cane Corso. I did not know how he was going to respond. He's been very well in the past of going to a vet. The staff is amazing! I called them from the car let them know I was there so that I can get the dog straight into the room just in case he became scared or aggressive. The doctor is wonderful the personalities of everyone that we encountered was amazing. It felt very warm and in inviting. The instructions for his care was not overwhelming or convoluted. My husband and I are so delighted that we found a veterinarian that is close to the house. That is bright in scenery and personality. Our first impression was amazing. We have an appointment with both of our dogs next month I will follow up but I have no doubt that it's going to be just as amazing as our visit was today.

I don’t often write positive reviews but this is worth of one. They fit me in when fully booked at the end of the day to see my boy who got a puncture wound. They’re always professional, thorough and explain everything in a way that’s easy to understand. Such kind compassionate vets and tech who truly love the animals. So happy to have you in the neighborhood!

We have searched our records and cannot find a pet parent matching your description.  If you are a Rox Falls pet parent, we encourage you to call the office and we will do our best to address any concerns.  Thank you.

I am writing this review in the hope that no other pet owner has an experience like mine. I came to Rox Falls after a scary ER visit with my dog and, based on the glowing reviews, expected thorough and compassionate care. Unfortunately, that was not my experience.
My dog presented with classic signs of juvenile cellulitis (puppy strangles), a condition he had previously been diagnosed with. Despite this, he was prescribed a steroid dose more appropriate for a 10lb dog rather than his actual 50lb weight — even lower than what he was given as a puppy. As a result, his condition continued to worsen. Rather than catching this mistake, I was informed via email that my dog likely had cancer and was told he needed a sedated biopsy that same night — something not appropriate while on steroids.
At that point I sought a second opinion. Once on the correct medication dosage, my dog began to improve rapidly. I also consulted internal medicine, and the specialist confirmed that the prescribed dosage from Rox Falls was not appropriate for his size.
This entire ordeal caused weeks of unnecessary stress, confusion, and pain for both my dog and myself. I am deeply disappointed not only by the initial prescribing error, but also by the lack of communication, compassion, and follow-up I experienced. Ultimately, it was my own persistence in questioning the care plan that led to my dog’s recovery.
Pet owners trust veterinarians with their family members. At the very least, this means careful dosing, clear communication, and compassion in delivering difficult news. My sincere hope is that sharing this experience encourages more diligence moving forward.

I don’t think I’ve ever been to a facility like this. From the front desk staff, to the tech team, to the doctors. I’ve never felt more like my pet was their pet. They are so reasonable and make you feel like you’re making the best choice for your pet and give you an array of options so I didn’t feel like I had to spend a bunch of money. Compassion is an understatement for both the pet and pet parent, I cannot recommend them enough. Especially doctors Mike and Lindsay, tech Dawn and Sam. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

I took my cat, Snow, to Rox Falls Vet this morning and had an absolute 10/10 experience. The staff was prompt and we were seen right away, which made everything smooth and stress-free. Dr. Bates and the nurse (I wish I had caught her name!) were both so gentle with Snow. She was a little nervous at first, but they handled her with such care that she quickly relaxed. Now that we’re home, she’s clearly much more comfortable and happy, and I’m so relieved they were able to ease all of her discomfort.
Excellent service and consultation for my dog. Clear communication and follow up. Highly recommended.
Best care ever!!!
One of the best vet experiences ever. Friendly, professional, reasaonable.
They are the best!!!
Best vet in town!  Everybody is caring and qualified!!
Ears infected
Samantha and Dr. Mike are the best!

We feel so lucky to have found this veterinary team! Every staff member from the front desk to the techs and doctors have been fantastic with our cat Toad, who’s become a bit of a frequent flyer here. They’re kind, thorough, and always make us feel supported. Couldn’t ask for better care!
Thanks so much for the review!

We moved to Philly two years ago and finding Rox Fall Vet has been a true blessing. The doctors and staff are amazing - knowledgeable, thorough and caring. They have taken great care of our two dogs. We highly recommend them!

Dr. Mike and all of the staff at Rox Falls Vet are incredible. You can feel how much they care, and it is very obvious that they love what they do. Dr. Mike has taken such great care of my pets, and I am forever thankful for his unwavering compassion, guidance, and sincerity. His as well as his staffs expertise is very apparent in how well they handle, treat, diagnose, and manage care. Im so grateful that my hamsters could be seen here, and I know it was the best choice I could have made.
Took great care of my cat and taught us how to manage his insulin for his feline diabetes
helpful, easy to get appointments. Thoughtful techs and vets who take good care.
The sweetest people.  From the front desk to the doctors.  Makes a huge difference.
Thank you for your review!
Clean environment, well-lit. Excellent and courteous staff. Dr. Bates was extremely thorough and clear and concise in his communication along with his assistant. Both were also caring.

Choosing this vet was the best thing I did for my puppy. You can tell everyone truly loves their job! The medical staff listen and i  feel heard as a pet parent and all my issues are addressed in timely manner. They even reached out the next day to make sure my puppy handled their first shots well . This has made being a new pet parent a easy fun and rewarding experience. Thanks you to all the staff at Rox Falls
Thank you for your review!
Great vet and they are very convenient. It's busy there, but also still really clean and easy and you can see why it's busy!
Thank you for the 5-star review!
Thank you for your review!

Whether it’s a routine check-up or something more involved—like the dental work my pet recently needed—visits to the vet can naturally come with a bit of anxiety. But Rox Falls Vet went above and beyond to put both me and my pet at ease from the moment we walked in.

The staff is incredibly friendly, compassionate, and welcoming. They take the time to explain every step of the process clearly, and somehow they always seem to answer your questions before you even think to ask them. That kind of attentiveness and care is rare and truly appreciated.

It’s clear this team genuinely loves what they do, and it shows in the way they treat both animals and their people. I can’t recommend them highly enough and will absolutely be sending friends and family their way. Thank you, Rox Falls Vet, for making what could’ve been a stressful day feel calm and reassuring.
